docs.title: How to manage multiCDN domains in HiddifyManager
Managing Clean IPs and Multiple CDN and AutoCDN Domains in Hiddify Manager
docs.text: In this article, we explore strategies for managing clean IPs tailored to different operators and setting up multiple CDN domains in Hiddify Manager. These methods optimize configuration and improve connection stability for users.

docs.title: Using Clean IPs for Different Operators
Step 1: Scanning Clean IPs
docs.text: Use the Morteza Bashsiz Scanner with the updated Xray core to identify clean IPs. For ease of use, an Android version with a user-friendly interface is also available.

docs.title: Step 2: Clean IP Format for Operators
docs.text:
To define clean IPs for different operators, use the following format: 

1.1.1.1 MCI > Hamrah Aval  
2.2.2.2 MTN > Irancell  
3.3.3.3 RTL > RighTel  
4.4.4.4 MKH > Mokhaberat  
5.5.5.5 SBN > Sabanet  
6.6.6.6 HWB > HiWeb  
7.7.7.7 SHT > Shatel Mobile

docs.title: Alternative Methods for Clean IPs
docs.text:
1. Using Cloudflare IPs: Test IPs using check-host.net. If "Cloudflare" appears in the ISP or Organization field, you can use these IPs for alternative configurations.

  2. Using the Main Server IP: Direct server IPs or IPs behind subdomains can work if they perform well with specific operators.

  3. Using IPv6: If the operator supports IPv6, this can be an effective solution. Ensure the client settings are adjusted to IPv6/IPv4.

docs.title: Approach 1: Creating Subdomains with Clean IPs
docs.text:
1. Define CDN Subdomains: Set up CDN subdomains with the proxy enabled: 

    sub1.domain.com (proxy on)  
sub2.domain.com (proxy on)  
sub3.domain.com (proxy on)

  2. Assign Clean IPs for Each Operator: Create subdomains with the proxy disabled for each clean IP: 

    mci.domain.com (proxy off)  ==> Clean IP for Hamrah Aval  
irc.domain.com (proxy off)  ==> Clean IP for Irancell  
mkb.domain.com (proxy off)  ==> Clean IP for Mokhaberat

  3. Add Subdomains in Hiddify Manager: Assign each subdomain to its respective operator.

docs.title: Approach 2: Using a Second Domain for CDN
docs.text:
1. Set up CDN Subdomains for the First Domain: 

    sub1.domain1.com (proxy on)  
sub2.domain1.com (proxy on)  
sub3.domain1.com (proxy on)

  2. Set Clean IP Subdomains for the First Domain: 

    mci.domain1.com (proxy off)  ==> Clean IP for Hamrah Aval  
irc.domain1.com (proxy off)  ==> Clean IP for Irancell  
mkb.domain1.com (proxy off)  ==> Clean IP for Mokhaberat

  3. Create CNAME Records for the Second Domain: 

    sub1.domain2.com ==> sub1.domain1.com (proxy off)  
sub2.domain2.com ==> sub2.domain1.com (proxy off)  
sub3.domain2.com ==> sub3.domain1.com (proxy off)

docs.title: Approach 3: AutoCDN with Tags
docs.text:
1. Set Up a Single AutoCDN Subdomain: 

    sub.domain.com (proxy on)

  2. Define Tags for Operators: 

    mci.ircf.space MCI  
mtn.ircf.space MTN  
mkh.ircf.space MKH  
rtl.ircf.space RTL

docs.title: Combining Subdomains and Tags for Optimal Configuration
docs.text:
To integrate clean IPs with AutoCDN features, follow these steps:

  1. Create a Subdomain with the Main Server IP (proxy off).
  2. Define Multiple Subdomains with Clean IPs for Each Operator: Ensure that each subdomain is linked to the clean IPs you scanned.

  3. Set Up a CDN Domain in Hiddify Manager: Enter three subdomains with distinct clean IPs for different operators in the "Force IP Usage" field.

  4. Assign Compatible Operator Tags: Assign operator tags (e.g., MCI, MTN) to each subdomain. This ensures the client scans for the best operator-specific subdomain during configuration.

By applying these methods, you can efficiently manage your domains and IPs in Hiddify Manager, enhancing performance and reliability for your users.

How to use Cloudflare worker domain on HiddifyManager (Automated way)

docs.title: 4to6 Tunnel
docs.text:
The 4to6 tunnel is similar to the 6to4 tunnel with the following advantages:

  1. Your effective IP address between two servers will be IPv6.
  2. IPv6 is inexpensive and can be changed easily if blocked.
  3. Your IPv4 addresses on both sides will be protected from blocking.

docs.title: Technical Overview
docs.text:
The setup involves two nodes, A and B:

Tehran ------------------GFW----------------- Tokyo 
   A <---------------------------------------> B

A tunnel is created between these two nodes:

Tehran ------------------------------------------GFW----------------------------------------- Tokyo 
   A                                                                                          B
| virtual IPv4 <---- 4to6 ----> real IPv6 | <------IPv6-----> | real IPv6 <---- 4to6 ----> virtual IPv4 |

IPv4 packets are encapsulated within IPv6 packets and transmitted over an IPv6 network. If an IP is blocked, it will be an IPv6 address and can be easily replaced, as IPv6 addresses are generally more cost-effective than IPv4 addresses.

docs.title: How to Use
docs.text: You will need two servers with IPv6.

docs.title: Server A
docs.text:
curl -o /tmp/4to6install.sh https://raw.githubusercontent.com/meshya/4to6-tunnel/main/scripts/install.sh; sudo bash /tmp/4to6install.sh; rm /tmp/4to6install.sh
Field Value E0 Server A IPv6 E2 Server B IPv6 E4 192.168.1.1/24

docs.title: Server B
docs.text:
curl -o /tmp/4to6install.sh https://raw.githubusercontent.com/meshya/4to6-tunnel/main/scripts/install.sh; sudo bash /tmp/4to6install.sh; rm /tmp/4to6install.sh
Field Value E0 Server B IPv6 E2 Server A IPv6 E4 192.168.1.2/24

docs.title: On Server A
docs.text: ping 192.168.1.2

docs.title: On Server B
docs.text: ping 192.168.1.1

docs.title: Warning
docs.text: If one of your servers is already using a 192.168.x.x network, you may need to use 172.16.x.x/12 (e.g., 172.16.0.1/12 and 172.16.0.2/12) instead. If you are unsure, open an issue and include the output of ip addr.

docs.title: Use Options
docs.text:
There are three methods to use the tunnel:

  1. IP/Port Forwarding
  2. Use Xray on Both Servers
  3. Use Custom Tunneling Methods

docs.title: IP/Port Forwarding
docs.text:
For those unfamiliar with IP/Port forwarding, it is recommended to read more about it and perform the configuration manually.

This article provides guidance on setting up port forwarding.

Here is a quick setup guide:

To forward a single port (e.g., port 80), use the following settings (assuming virtual IPs of 192.168.1.1 for Server A and 192.168.1.2 for Server B).

docs.title: Server A
docs.text: iptables -t nat -A PREROUTING -p tcp --dport 80 -j DNAT --to-destination 192.168.1.2:80 iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -j MASQUERADE

docs.title: Step 2
docs.text: If the setup works, add the commands to local.rc.

docs.title: Use Xray on Both Servers
docs.text:
Install the Xray service on both servers and configure Server A to route data through a proxy on Server B. This configuration can be simplified using 3x-ui. For assistance, contact me (I am available as meshya everywhere and meshyah on Telegram).

Note: Use 192.168.1.2 instead of the real IP of Server B when configuring Xray on Server A.

docs.title: Use Custom Tunneling Methods
docs.text:
While not recommended, you can use custom tunneling methods such as Reverse TLS or Fake TLS on top of the 4to6 tunnel if you are familiar with these techniques.

Note: Use virtual IPs (192.168.x.x) instead of real IPs.

docs.title: Tip
docs.text: When using Method 2, consider adjusting routing rules and utilizing the Iran Hosted Domain Project to direct traffic for Iran-hosted websites and services, especially Shaparak and payment services, from an Iranian IP. This setup will prevent users from needing to toggle their proxies.

docs.title: References
docs.text:
1. 4to6 tunneling - Meshya

  2. Linux document project - ip4 in ip6 tunneling

  3. RFC2437

Article and main repo by Meshya

docs.title: The admin link in HiddifyManager and its format
The admin link in HiddifyManager and its format
docs.text: This page explains what each part of your admin link means, what happens when you open it, and how to get it back if you lose it. It is for anyone who manages a HiddifyManager panel.

docs.title: The format of the admin link
docs.text:
The installer prints your admin link at the end of the installation. It looks like this:

https://sub.example.com/DrtGho0n4b8H9D/8bncvfb5-8193-vv76-ab97-4c35965l250m/

The general form is:

https://<domain>/<admin proxy path>/<admin UUID>/

The parts are separated by /:

  1. https://: the connection is encrypted with TLS. Always use https links. An http link sends everything without encryption.
  2. Domain (sub.example.com): one of the domains you added in the panel (Direct, CDN or Relay). See Domain types.
  3. Admin proxy path (DrtGho0n4b8H9D): a secret path that hides the panel from bots and filtering systems. It is the setting Proxy Path for Admins. Users have a different path (Proxy Path for Clients).
  4. Admin UUID (8bncvfb5-...): your personal secret ID. Each admin has their own. Treat it like a password.

Keep your admin link private

Anyone who has your admin link can manage your panel, unless you set a password for your admin account.

The link changes if you change your domain, the admin proxy path, or your admin UUID. Save the new link before you change any of them.

docs.title: What happens when you open the link
docs.text:
1. You open the admin link in your browser.

  2. The panel signs you in and opens Admin V2, the new admin panel. The address in your browser changes to:

    https://sub.example.com/DrtGho0n4b8H9D/admin/v2/

    The UUID is removed from the address bar, so it is not shown on your screen.

  3. Your sign-in lasts up to 10 days in that browser. After that, or in a new browser, you see the Sign in page.

On the Sign in page:

  • In Admin ID or username, enter the UUID from your admin link (or the username you were given).
  • In Password, enter your password. Leave it empty if your admin account has no password.
  • Select Sign in.

The easiest way is to open your full admin link again. It fills in your ID automatically.

The screenshots above are from an older version. The sign-in page now has separate fields for the ID and the password.

docs.title: If you lost your admin link
docs.text:
Connect to your server over SSH and run:

hiddify admin

It prints your admin links. Use a Secure https link with your domain. The link with the server's IP is "Not Secure"; use it only if the domain links do not work.

If you set a password and forgot it, reset the owner admin's password on the server with:

hiddify reset-password

Tip

Save your full admin link somewhere safe, such as a password manager, so you always have it when you need it.

docs.title: How to change the parts of the link
docs.text:
• Admin proxy path: in the panel, open Settings, search for "Proxy Path for Admins", change it, and apply the changes. The panel then shows the new admin address.
  • Admin UUID: open the Admins page, edit the admin, and change the UUID field. The old admin link for that admin stops working.

docs.title: Tutorial for setting up Dokodemo-Door tunnel as relay server
docs.text:
For this you need an relay server to connect to the main server. Usually this middle server is considered in Iran. The tunnel usage diagram is as follows.

  • SSH to the relay server and run Xray kernel installation command
sudo bash -c "$(curl -L https://github.com/XTLS/Xray-install/raw/main/install-release.sh)" @ install
  • After installation, you must create the config.json file with the following command.
nano /usr/local/etc/xray/config.json
  • Now see the code below which is related to the inbound'' andoutbound'' traffic of the dokodemo-Door tunnel.
{
   "inbounds": [
     {
       "listen": "127.0.0.1",
       "port": 62789,
       "protocol": "dokodemo-Door",
       "settings": {
         "address": "127.0.0.1"
       },
       "tag": "api"
     },
     {
       "listen": null,
       "port": Main_Server_Port,
       "protocol": "dokodemo-Door",
       "settings": {
         "address": "MAIN_SERVER_IP",
         "followRedirect": false,
         "network": "tcp,udp",
         "port": MAIN_SERVER_PORT
       },
       "tag": "inbound-MAIN_SERVER_PORT"
     }
   ],
   "outbounds": [
     {
       "protocol": "freedom"
     },
     {
       "protocol": "blackhole",
       "tag": "blocked"
     }
   ]
}
  • In the MAIN_SERVER_PORT port field, put the port of your main server (HiddifyManager) that you considered for the tunnel connection on that server.
  • For example, port 443 is used by HiddifyManager by default for routers.
  • In the MAIN_SERVER_IP section, you should put your main server's IP address.
  • For example, if your server's IP is 10.10.10.10 and its port is 443, then the inbound code will be as follows:
{
   "inbounds": [
     {
       "listen": "127.0.0.1",
       "port": 62789,
       "protocol": "dokodemo-Door",
       "settings": {
         "address": "127.0.0.1"
       },
       "tag": "api"
     },
     {
       "listen": null,
       "port": 443,
       "protocol": "dokodemo-Door",
       "settings": {
         "address": "10.10.10.10",
         "followRedirect": false,
         "network": "tcp,udp",
         "port": 443
       },
       "tag": "inbound-443"
     }
   ],
   "outbounds": [
     {
       "protocol": "freedom"
     },
     {
       "protocol": "blackhole",
       "tag": "blocked"
     }
   ]
}

After performing the configuration operation, press Ctrl + s button to save the changes and press Ctrl + x to exit the config.json file.

docs.title: Defining several different inbounds in the relay server to connect to several primary servers
docs.text:
For this, it is enough to define a new inbound in the config.json code after finishing each inbound. For example, suppose we have two main servers, the IP of the first server is 10.10.10.10 and its port is 443, the IP of the second server is 20.20.20.20 and its port is 8443. To create two independent tunnels to these servers, two inbound must be created as follows.

{
   "inbounds": [
     {
       "listen": "127.0.0.1",
       "port": 62789,
       "protocol": "dokodemo-Door",
       "settings": {
         "address": "127.0.0.1"
       },
       "tag": "api"
     },
     {
       "listen": null,
       "port": 443,
       "protocol": "dokodemo-Door",
       "settings": {
         "address": "10.10.10.10",
         "followRedirect": false,
         "network": "tcp,udp",
         "port": 443
       },
       "tag": "inbound-443"
     }
    {
       "listen": null,
       "port": 8443,
       "protocol": "dokodemo-Door",
       "settings": {
         "address": "20.20.20.20",
         "followRedirect": false,
         "network": "tcp,udp",
         "port": 8443
       },
       "tag": "inbound-8443"
     }
   ],
   "outbounds": [
     {
       "protocol": "freedom"
     },
     {
       "protocol": "blackhole",
       "tag": "blocked"
     }
   ]
}
  • After saving the file, hit restart the Xray kernel.
sudo systemctl restart xray

docs.title: Adding Relay server to HiddifyManager
docs.text: Now, register a subdomain with the proxy off for your relay server IP and register it in Hiddify Manager on Relay mode. - Put the registered subdomain in the Domain field and you can also set a Alias to display in the configurations.

docs.title: Adding Relay configurations to subscription link
docs.text:
As always in HiddifyManager, it is better to separate the configs from the subscription link. Therefore, for the registered Relay domain, you can check the Relay domain in the subscription domain settings so that its configurations are added to the subscription domain.

Assuming that the subscription domain is sublink.hiddify.com, proceed as shown below to get the job done.

Now, if you open the user page with the subscription domain (here sublink.hiddify.com), you will see that the connections related to the relay server have also been added. You can add and use these connections individually or using subscription links to your client.

docs.title: Remove the Dokodemo-Door settings from the relay server
docs.text:
• To do this, first run this command.
sudo rm /usr/local/etc/xray/config.json
  • Then stop and delete the Xray core.

sudo systemctl stop xray && systemctl disable xray
````

- Finally, enter this command to completely remove the app and service.
bash -c "$(curl -L https://github.com/XTLS/Xray-install/raw/main/install-release.sh)" @ remove ```

docs.title: Tutorial for setting up GOST tunnel as relay server
docs.text:
This page shows you how to turn a server into a relay for your Hiddify Manager server using GOST (GO Simple Tunnel), a small open-source program that forwards ports from one server to another.

A relay server is a second server, usually inside your own country, that your users connect to. It forwards their traffic to your main Hiddify server abroad. This helps when the main server's IP is blocked or slow from your country. Read more about relay servers.

There is also a video tutorial in Persian for this method.

docs.title: Why GOST instead of plain IP-Tables forwarding?
docs.text:
• You can point the tunnel at your main server's domain instead of its IP, so the IP does not appear in the relay's settings.
  • It runs as a system service, so it starts again by itself after a reboot.
  • It works with any protocol Hiddify offers (VLESS, VMess, Trojan, WebSocket, gRPC and others), because it forwards raw TCP traffic. Your proxy traffic stays encrypted by the proxy protocol itself.
  • You can forward as many ports as you like, TCP or UDP.

Easier option

Hiddify Relay Builder can install GOST for you from a menu.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• A main server with Hiddify Manager installed. See the installation guide.
  • A relay server running Ubuntu or Debian, with SSH access as root. New to SSH? See how to connect to a server via SSH.
  • A domain that points directly to your main server's IP (proxy off, not through a CDN), or just the main server's IP.

docs.title: Install GOST on the relay server
docs.text:
1. Connect to your relay server over SSH.

  2. Download GOST and unpack it:

    sudo apt install wget nano -y
wget https://github.com/ginuerzh/gost/releases/download/v2.11.5/gost-linux-amd64-2.11.5.gz
gunzip gost-linux-amd64-2.11.5.gz

    This is the build for normal x86-64 (amd64) servers. On an ARM server, use gost-linux-armv8-2.11.5.gz instead, and change the file name in the next step to match.

  3. Move the program to the system folder and make it executable:

    sudo mv gost-linux-amd64-2.11.5 /usr/local/bin/gost
sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/gost

  4. Create a service file, so GOST runs in the background and after reboots. Open the editor:

    sudo nano /usr/lib/systemd/system/gost.service

  5. Paste this text into the editor:

    [Unit]
Description=GO Simple Tunnel
After=network.target
Wants=network.target
[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/gost -L=tcp://:443/domain.com:443 -L=tcp://:80/domain.com:80
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

  6. Replace both domain.com with your main server's direct domain (or its IP).

  7. Save with Ctrl+S and exit with Ctrl+X. (In older nano versions, press Ctrl+X, then Y, then Enter.)

  8. Start the service and make it start on every boot:

    sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable --now gost

docs.title: Check that it worked
docs.text:
sudo systemctl status gost

You should see active (running). Press q to leave this screen. If it says failed, check the ExecStart line for typos, fix it, and run the two commands from step 8 again.

To forward more ports, add another -L=tcp://:PORT/domain.com:PORT to the ExecStart line. For UDP, write udp:// instead of tcp://.

About GOST versions

This page uses GOST v2.11.5 from the original ginuerzh/gost project. Its last release is v2.12.0 (October 2024). The actively developed version is GOST v3 at go-gost/gost; Hiddify Relay Builder installs v3 and uses the same -L=tcp://... style of command.

docs.title: Add the relay server to Hiddify Manager
docs.text:
1. Point a subdomain (for example relay.example.com) at the relay server's IP with an A record. On Cloudflare, keep the proxy off (grey cloud).
  2. In the panel, open Domains, click Add domain, enter the subdomain and choose the mode Relay.
  3. Edit your subscription domain, select the relay domain under Show configs of, then apply the changes.

For the full steps, see How to add a relay server (domain) to HiddifyManager.

Screenshots from an older panel version

docs.title: Remove GOST from the relay server
docs.text:
Run these commands on the relay server:

sudo systemctl disable --now gost
sudo rm -f /usr/lib/systemd/system/gost.service /usr/local/bin/gost
sudo systemctl daemon-reload

docs.title: Tutorial for setting up HA-Proxy tunnel as relay server
docs.text:
For this you need an relay server to connect to the main server. Usually, this relay server is considered in the country of residence.

Now, HA-proxy tunnel is used here for the communication between the relay server and the main server. After installation, you will connect to the relay server, that server will connect you to the main server, and then you will have free access to the Internet from the main server.

Note: We tested these scripts on Ubuntu 22.04, so it is better to use this version.

docs.title: Installing the HA-proxy tunnel on the relay server and connecting it to the external server
docs.text:
• For this you need an relay server to connect to the main server through it. Usually, this relay server is considered in the country of residence.

  • (Connect via SSH to the relay server)[/manager/installation-and-setup/How-to-connect-to-server-via-SSH/] and run the HA-proxy installation command.

sudo apt-get install haproxy
  • After installation, you need to change the haproxy.cfg file, run the command to open the haproxy.cfg file with the nano text editor.
nano /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg
  • When the haproxy.cfg file opens, go to the end of the file and add the following example:
frontend myfrontend
     bind *:RELAY_PORT
     mode tcp
     default_backend mybackend

backend mybackend
     mode tcp
     server target_server MAIN_SERVER_IP:MAIN_SERVER_PORT

  • In the RELAY_PORT section, put the port of your relay server that you consider for sending requests to the main server.

  • In the field MAIN_SERVER_IP:MAIN_SERVER_PORT, you should put the IP and port of your main server. For example, port 443 is used by HiddifyManager by default.

  • For example, if the IP of your main server is 10.10.10.10, in this case, to transfer user traffic on port 443 through the relay server to the main server, the desired file should be as follows:

frontend myfrontend
     bind *:443
     mode tcp
     default_backend mybackend

backend mybackend
     mode tcp
     server target_server 10.10.10.10:443

  • After making the changes, save the changes by pressing Ctrl + s buttons and exit the file by pressing Ctrl + x.

  • After saving the file, press the command to restart HAProxy.

sudo systemctl restart haproxy

docs.title: Removing the HA-Proxy tunnel from the relay server

docs.title: Tutorial for setting up IP-Table tunnel as relay server
docs.text:
This page shows you how to turn a server into a relay for your Hiddify Manager server using IP-Tables, the firewall built into Linux. It is the simplest method: one script, no extra software to keep running.

A relay server is a second server, usually inside your own country, that your users connect to. It forwards their traffic to your main Hiddify server abroad. This helps when the main server's IP is blocked or slow from your country. Read more about relay servers.

There is also a video tutorial in Persian for this method.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• A main server with Hiddify Manager installed. See the installation guide.
  • A relay server running Ubuntu or Debian, with a clean IP and enough bandwidth and CPU for your users. RAM matters little: a small, cheap server (for example 256 MB of RAM) is enough, and you can run several of them.
  • SSH access to the relay server as root. New to SSH? See how to connect to a server via SSH.
  • The IP address of your main server.

docs.title: Set up the relay server
docs.text:
1. Connect to your relay server over SSH.

  2. Run this command:

    bash <(curl https://gist.githubusercontent.com/hiddify-com/63836c9a158eca29bad6c941610028cf/raw/0e4e2138148ab9d3d678723fd904b1cad461ce62/relay.sh)

  3. When asked Enter your main server IP like(1.1.1.1):, type your main server's IP and press Enter.

  4. The script installs iptables and iptables-persistent. If a blue screen asks whether to save the current IPv4 (and IPv6) rules, choose Yes.

    The script forwards TCP ports 80 and 443, and all UDP traffic, to your main server, and saves the rules so they come back after a reboot.

  5. The script turns on IP forwarding (needed for the tunnel) only until the next reboot. Make it permanent:

    echo "net.ipv4.ip_forward=1" | sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/99-relay.conf
sudo sysctl --system

docs.title: Check that it worked
docs.text:
Run this on the relay server:

sudo iptables -t nat -L -n

You should see DNAT lines that point to your main server's IP. If you do not, run the script again and check the IP you typed.

docs.title: Add the relay server to Hiddify Manager
docs.text:
1. Point a subdomain (for example relay.example.com) at the relay server's IP with an A record. On Cloudflare, keep the proxy off (grey cloud).
  2. In the panel, open Domains, click Add domain, enter the subdomain and choose the mode Relay.
  3. Edit your subscription domain, select the relay domain under Show configs of, then apply the changes.

For the full steps, see How to add a relay server (domain) to HiddifyManager.

Screenshots from an older panel version

docs.title: Remove the relay rules
docs.text:
The forwarding rules live in the nat table. To delete them and save the empty rule set, run this on the relay server:

sudo iptables -t nat -F
sudo iptables-save | sudo tee /etc/iptables/rules.v4

Warning

This deletes every rule in the nat table, including any you added yourself.

To also turn IP forwarding off, delete the file you created:

sudo rm /etc/sysctl.d/99-relay.conf

docs.title: Tutorial for setting up IPv6 to improve Relay stability
Using Main Servers' IPV6 for Tunnel Resilience
docs.text: Using Tunnel with IPv6 for bypassing filtering systems and creating a stable connection has become an effective and popular method. This approach provides high flexibility, especially for relay servers and main servers, and can improve connection quality.

docs.title: Tunnel Method with IPV6
docs.text:
Using IPV6 can be done in two different ways for connecting between relay servers and main servers:

  1. Creating a local IPV6 on two relay and main servers and connecting the main server IPV6 to the relay server network.

  2. Using the main server's IPV6 on both relay and main servers and connecting the main server IPV6 to the Iran network. This method requires that both relay servers have IPV6 enabled on their network cards, which can be verified with the ip a command in the server's terminal.

Note: The best methods for these two approaches are Gost and Decodemodoor, which have been practically tested.

docs.title: How to Perform the Process
docs.text:
It doesn’t matter which method you use, for optimal performance, you need to use the relay server mid-scripter on Hiddify Manager.

  1. Review the related mid-scripter article for Hiddify for installation instructions on the relay server.

  2. Execute the script installation command, and after installation is complete, the mid-scripter environment will be displayed for you.

This interface contains various tunnel methods and related script settings. Choose either Gost or Decodemodoor.

  1. Select the first option based on your chosen method, then choose add inbounds and enter the main server’s IPV6 or local IPV6 in the correct format.

  2. After entering the IPV6, proceed to select a port and enter a desired port.

  3. Done! Now, log into Hiddify Manager, select the relay option from the domains section, enter Cloudflare, and create a record A with your desired domain and IPV4 server in Iran. Input the subdomain address in the relay domain section and save it.

docs.title: Suggested Proxies
docs.text:
• http tcp relay vmess
  • http httpupgrade relay vmess

These methods can help create a stable and secure connection, especially in filtering conditions.

docs.title: Tutorial for setting up WST tunnel as relay server
docs.text:
For this you need an relay server to connect to the main server. Usually this relay server is considered in Iran. The tunnel usage diagram is as follows.

Now here, WS tunnel is used for communication between Iran server and main server. After installation, you will connect to the Iranian server, the Iranian server will connect you to the main server, and then you will have free access to the Internet from the main server.

Note: We tested these scripts on Ubuntu 22.04, so it is better to use this version.

On the main server, install HiddifyManager, whose installation guide is available at here.

docs.title: Installing the tunnel on the main and relay server (Iran)
docs.text:
You must install this tunnel program on both servers. To do this, first connect to the server with root and run the following codes: First, download the program with the following command. 

wget "https://github.com/erebe/wstunnel/releases/download/v5.0/wstunnel-linux-x64"
Give it execute access. 
sudo chmod +x wstunnel-linux-x64
Rename the program with the command and move it to the bin/ folder. 
sudo mv wstunnel-linux-x64 /bin/wstunnel

docs.title: Running the tunnel on the main server
docs.text:
On the main server where HiddifyManager is installed, you need to run the installed tunnel. Activate it on port 8080 with this command.

sudo wstunnel --server ws://0.0.0.0:8080 -v

Note: If you change the tunnel port, the ports must be the same on both servers.

  • Pay attention, after entering this command, the message ``WAIT for tcp connection on 0.0.0.0:8080'' is given, which means the successful execution of the tunnel and waiting for the link to be established in the relay server, because this tunnel requires communication from both has the position

The work of setting up the tunnel on the main server is also finished.

docs.title: Running the tunnel on the relay server
docs.text:
To set up the tunnel on the relay server using this command, you must provide both the required ports for downloading and the port that the tunnel uses to communicate. Here, port 8080 is used for the tunnel itself, which was configured on the main server side. Also, the HiddifyManager program uses ports 443 and 80 automatically, so you can put them in the following command.

  • If you change the default ports of HiddifyManager panel, change ports 443 and 80 according to the same formula.

  • If you want to download another port, you can do it with the same formula.

sudo wstunnel -L 0.0.0.0:80:localhost:80 -L 0.0.0.0:443:localhost:443 ws://[cdn_or_direct_domain_of_main_server]:8080
  • Please note that [server_adress_or_domain] should be placed with the CDN or direct domain registered in Hidify or the main IP of the server.
  • If you do this with the CDN domain, you will also prevent the main server from being filtered.

  • Pay attention to the message after typing this command ``WAIT for tcp connection on 0.0.0.0:80, WAIT for tcp connection on 0.0.0.0:443'' is given, which means the successful execution of the tunnel and waiting for the connection to be established from the client side.

  • If the main tunnel port (here 8080) is filtered on your Iranian data center, you can use other ports.

  • Very important note: If you use CDN domains to establish a tunnel, you are only allowed to use Cloudflare ports. That is, you can only use Cloudflare's https ports for connection, and you can use Cloudflare's http ports for the tunnel itself. List of Cloudflare ports

Work on setting up the ws tunnel on the relay server is complete.

docs.title: Setting up the tunnel service on the main server
docs.text:
You only need to create its service so that if the server is reset, the tunnel will run automatically. To do this, exit the created tunnel with Ctrl+c, then with a text editor (here nano) create the service file in the main path of the kernel.

sudo nano /etc/systemd/system/wstunnel.service

Then in the opened file, copy the following text to define the desired service.

[Unit]
Description=wstunnel
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/bin
ExecStart= wstunnel --server ws://0.0.0.0:8080 -v
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

To exit the text editor, press Ctrl+s to save the file, then exit the program with Ctrl+x.

Now reset the main kernel service and activate and start the created service.

sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable wstunnel.service
sudo systemctl start wstunnel.service
Now, to check if the service is activated, type this command and check that the service is active. 
sudo systemctl status wstunnel.service

If for any reason the service was not active, one of the previous steps was probably not done correctly.

docs.title: Setting up the tunnel service on relay server
docs.text:
You only need to create its service so that if the server is reset, the tunnel will run automatically. To do this, create the service file in the main path of the kernel with a text editor (here nano). 

sudo nano /etc/systemd/system/wstunnel.service
Then in the opened file, copy the following text to define the desired service.

[Unit]
Description=wstunnel
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/bin
ExecStart= wstunnel -L 0.0.0.0:80:localhost:80 -L 0.0.0.0:443:localhost:443 ws://[cdn_or_direct_domain_of_main_server]:8080
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
  • Make sure to paste cdn_or_direct_domain_of_main_server with your direct domain or CDN specification.
  • To exit the text editor, first press Ctrl + s to save the file, then exit the program with Ctrl + x.

Now reset the main kernel service and activate and start the created service.

sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable wstunnel.service
sudo systemctl start wstunnel.service
Now, to check if the service is activated, type this command and check that the service is active. 
sudo systemctl status wstunnel.service

If for any reason the service was not active, one of the previous steps was probably not done correctly.

docs.text:
First you need to stop and disable the service. 

sudo systemctl daemon-reload

Then delete the app and service.

docs.title: Tutorial for setting up local IPv6 for Relay server
Tutorial for setting up local IPv6 for Relay server
docs.text: In some relay servers, IPv6 may not be provided, and you can create a local IPv6 using this method in your tunnels.

docs.title: Relay server
docs.text:
To create local IPv6, you need to first install the iproute2 service on relay server with the following command.

sudo apt-get install iproute2

After installing the above service, create the tunnel.yaml file in the netplan folder with nano editor.

sudo nano /etc/netplan/tunnel.yaml

Then copy the following code in the file.

network:
version: 2
tunnels:
tunnel98:
mode: sit
local: IPv4-RELAY
remote: IPv4-MAIN
addresses:
- 2001:db9:900::1/64

  • Instead of IPv4-RELAY put your relay server IP and instead of IPv4-MAIN put your main server IP.

  • After making the changes, save the file by pressing the Ctrl+s button and exit the editor by pressing the Ctrl+x button.

  • At the end, apply the changes made in netplan with the following command.

sudo netplan apply

docs.title: Main server
docs.text:
To create local IPv6 on the main server, you need to install the iproute2 service.

sudo apt-get install iproute2

After installing the above service, create the tunnel.yaml file in the netplan folder with nano editor.

sudo nano /etc/netplan/tunnel.yaml

Then copy the following code into the file.

network:
version: 2
tunnels:
tunnel98:
mode: sit
local: IPv4-MAIN
remote: IPv4-RELAY
addresses:
- 2001:db9:900::2/64
  • Put the relay server IP instead of IPv4-RELAY and put your main server IP instead of IPv4-MAIN.
  • After making changes, save the file by pressing the Ctrl+s button and exit the editor by pressing the `Ctrl+x' button.
  • At the end, apply the changes made in netplan with the following command.
sudo netplan apply
  • The work is finished.

In this method, local IPv6s are as follows.

Your relay server:

2001:db9:900::1

Your main server:

2001:db9:900::2

docs.title: Connection test
docs.text:
To test the connection, just ping the IPv6 local relay server from your main server:

ping 2001:db9:900::1

Tip!

Please note that if the firewall is on on any of the servers, it is not possible to test through ping and it is necessary to turn off the firewall temporarily. Firewall setup

docs.title: How to use
docs.text:
You can use Dokodemo-Door or use GOST on your relay server and instead of IP or domain, use the local IPv6 that you created for the main server.

Example Dokodemo-Door:

{
"inbounds": [
{
"listen": "127.0.0.1",
"port": 62789,
"protocol": "dokodemo-Door",
"settings": {
"address": "127.0.0.1"
},
"tag": "api"
},
{
"listen": null,
"port": 443,
"protocol": "dokodemo-Door",
"settings": {
"address": "2001:db9:900::2",
"followRedirect": false,
"network": "tcp,udp",
"port": 443
},
"tag": "inbound-IPv6-local"
}
],
"outbounds": [
{
"protocol": "freedom"
},
{
"protocol": "blackhole",
"tag": "blocked"
}
]
}

If you pay attention, in the example above, the local IPv6 value created for the main server is placed in the address field, and 443 is entered in the port field, which you can change the port to the tunneled port.

To learn how to add a relay server (domain) to HiddifyManager, read this article do it

docs.title: How to use wildcard subdomains on HiddifyManager
How to use wildcard subdomains on HiddifyManager
Wildcard domain registration on Cloudflare
docs.text:
First, create a * record on your registered domain on Cloudflare. That is, go to the DNS section and click Add record. Then enter a star in the opened page. Fill the field type as A and the value of the IP field with the IP of your server. Make sure the proxy tick is on. That is, if, for example, your domain is yourdomain.com, finally register a field *.yourdomain.com. More information on how to register a domain

For IP version 6, you can do the same thing with a record of AAAA type.

docs.title: Registration of wildcard domain on Hiddify panel
docs.text:
To do this, go to the domain settings and create a new domain. Create a CDN or AutoCDN domain.

  • Therefore, enter *.yourdomain.com in the domain name field of the subdomain you registered in the previous step.

  • Give the alias a name of your choice.

  • Select the mode from CDN or AutoCDN. The difference between CDN domain and AutoCDN is in the way the address field is applied in the configuration, CDN returns the domain name and AutoCDN returns the IP. More information on this

  • Finally, save the settings to register the domain. If the message to apply changes is given, be sure to click the apply changes button so that the settings are fully applied to the server.

docs.title: Viewing configs of wildcard domain
docs.text: First, go to the subscription domain and tick the wildcard domain in the domain configuration field. Suppose that the domain of the subscription links is t1.hiddify.com, edit it and tick the wildcard domain as shown below. With this, the configs of wildcard domain are connected to the subscription link.

docs.title: Using configs of wildcard domain
docs.text:
Now, if you have different users on the server, you will see that the configurations created on the wildcard domain for each user, are created on a random subdomain and a separate subdomain is created for each user on Cloudflare.

This helps to prevent the subdomain from being blocked.

docs.title: What is CDN and how does it help us?
What is CDN and how does it help us?
docs.text: Ever wondered what a CDN is and why we need it to implement some filter breakers? In general, what does CDN help us to bypass filtering? In this article, we are going to take a general look at the CDN structure and how it works and at the end answer this question so that you can configure and implement it with a more open mind. So if you are not familiar with how it works, stay with us until the end of this post.

docs.title: CDN performance overview
docs.text:
CDN or Content Delivery Network is a set of connected servers around the world that are responsible for fast data transfer. In the content distribution network, the data placed on the website or applications is cached or stored in the CDN servers and allows users around the world to exchange information with that website or application at a faster rate. It also reduces ping and jitter by its very nature, but how is this possible? Suppose you need to visit a website in Iran or exchange information through a special program with America. If your destination platform does not use a CDN, to exchange information, the sent packet must travel the entire network path to the destination to deliver the request, and this process must be done again to return the packets. Naturally, in this scenario, due to the long distance between the user and the main server, it will not be possible to send and receive at high speed, and the delay in loading and loading pages is clearly visible. However, if the content distribution network is used in the above scenario, all the data of that platform is stored in the Origin servers or the edge server and the user is connected to the nearest edge server based on their geographical area and with faster speed and less delay than exchanging information with The destination takes action. In the picture below, you can see the overview of this scenario.

Now the question may be raised to you, what is the need to use this content distribution network in setting up the filter breaker with this account? Above we mentioned one of the benefits of using this technology, but the story does not end here. The important and vital thing that is used to set up filtering servers on this platform is that your server's IP is not identified from the point of view of regulatory bodies and filtering systems. As mentioned above, during the exchange of information with the destination server, the user is connected to the Origin Servers instead of direct communication, and these edge servers are responsible for exchanging information with the main server. With this account, the IP of your server remains hidden from the eyes of government monitoring institutions, and its filtering becomes remarkably impossible! Let's see the test and the result practically. Here we create an A record in Cloudflare and turn off the proxy (the ability to use CDN) for it so that the created subdomain does not use the CDN ability and is directly connected to the main server.

Then ping the created subdomain:

As you can see in the image above, the main IP of the server can be identified and filtered easily. In the next test, we enable the proxy option for the created subdomain and compare the results:

In this case, the test output is no longer the IP of the main server, but the IP of the edge servers that are closest to you and connected to. Also, in order to better understand how to reduce ping and jitter and increase speed when using CDN, we checked the route taken by packets by Tracing Route. The images below show that when using a CDN, the access path to the server is much shorter, so that in this example, the packets pass through more than 10 routers in direct mode, and this problem causes more delay and decreases its speed and performance.

docs.title: The reason why Cloudflare is not completely filtered
docs.text: Now, you may be wondering why government institutions have not completely filtered Cloudflare and other disruptions have been applied to the IPs under its control? It should be noted that Cloudflare is one of the largest and most unique content distribution networks in the world, which provides many services and tools to users. Many Iranian websites and service providers also use its services, and if Cloudflare is completely filtered, access to a large part of Iranian services will be blocked. For this reason, regulatory bodies act through other methods to disrupt this platform.

docs.title: Easy installation through the data center (Cloud-init)
Easy installation through the data center (Cloud-init)
docs.text:
Use this page if your server provider lets you paste a setup script when you create a server. Hiddify Manager then installs itself automatically, and you don't need to connect over SSH.

Cloud-init is a standard tool that runs a setup script the first time a new server starts. Most providers (Hetzner, Vultr, OVH, DigitalOcean and others) support it. The field is often called User data, Cloud-init or Custom data.

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
• Choose Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04 or 26.04 as the server's operating system. Other versions are not supported.
  • Choose an amd64 (x86_64) or arm64 server.

docs.title: Create the server
docs.text:
1. Start creating a new server in your provider's dashboard.
  2. Find the cloud-init / user data field.
  3. Copy the code below and paste it into that field.
#cloud-config
package_upgrade: true
packages:
- apt-transport-https
- ca-certificates
- curl
- wget
- gnupg-agent
- software-properties-common
- git
- jq
runcmd:
- cd /opt
- bash -c "export CREATE_EASYSETUP_LINK='true' NO_UI='true'; curl -s https://i.hiddify.com/release | bash -s -- --no-gui"
final_message: "The system is finally up, after $UPTIME seconds"
output: { all: "| tee -a /root/cloud-init-output.log" }
# About 10-15 minutes after the server starts, open http://YOUR-SERVER-IP/
# in your browser. This temporary setup link works for one hour only.

docs.title: Finish
docs.text:
1. Create the server.
  2. Wait 10 to 15 minutes for the installation to finish.
  3. Open http://YOUR-SERVER-IP/ in your browser (replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server's IP address). You will see a temporary link to your admin panel. This link works for one hour only, so open it soon.

If the page does not open after 15 minutes, wait a few more minutes and try again. If the hour has passed, connect to the server over SSH and get the admin links with the hiddify admin command (see the main installation guide).

Then continue with setting up the domain and finalizing the installation.

docs.title: Guide for setting up the domain and finalizing the installation (Initial setting after installation)
Guide for setting up the domain and finalizing the installation
docs.text:
After you install Hiddify Manager, you need to finish the setup. This page walks you through it in three steps:

  1. Get a domain (or subdomain) that points to your server.
  2. Open the admin panel.
  3. Enter your domain in the panel and get your connection links.

A domain is a name like example.com that points to your server's IP address, so you and your users don't have to use the bare IP. A subdomain is a name under a domain, like vpn.example.com.

Screenshots

The screenshots on this page come from older versions of the panel. Your screens may look different, but the steps are the same.

docs.title: Step 1: Get a domain and subdomain
docs.text:
If you already have a domain, create a subdomain for your server's IP address in your domain's DNS settings and skip to step 2.

If you don't have a domain, you can get a free subdomain from FreeDNS. The video below (in Persian) shows all the steps.

Steps to get a free subdomain from FreeDNS

  1. Go to freedns.afraid.org and create an account. You don't need to give real personal information, but the email address must be correct.

  2. Open the email FreeDNS sent you and click the activation link.

  3. Log in, open the domain registry and choose one of the public domains. Domains ending in .com, .net or .org are a good choice.

  4. Enter the subdomain name you want and your server's IP address, then save.

  5. Copy the subdomain you created. You need it in step 3.

These steps create a direct domain (it points straight to your server). To learn about other domain types, such as CDN domains, see Domain types and how to register them.

docs.title: Step 2: Open the admin panel
docs.text:
How you open the panel depends on how you installed Hiddify.

If you used cloud-init (Hetzner, Vultr, OVH, ...)

The installer creates a temporary link that works for one hour.

  1. Wait at least 10 minutes after the server starts.
  2. Open your server's IP address in your browser. An IP address is four numbers separated by dots. For example, if your IP is 1.1.1.1, open http://1.1.1.1.
  3. Click the link on that page to reach the admin panel.

If the hour has passed, use the SSH method below to get the admin links.

If you installed over SSH

At the end of the installation, the installer shows your admin links in the terminal. Open one of them in your browser.

  • Prefer the links marked Secure (with your domain and https://). Use the Not Secure IP link only if the others don't work yet.
  • An admin link looks like https://your-domain/admin-path/your-admin-id/. More about this: The correct format of the admin link.

To see the admin links again, connect to your server over SSH and run:

hiddify admin

If you forgot the admin password, you can reset it with:

hiddify reset-password

docs.title: Step 3: Finalize the installation
docs.text:
1. The first time you open the admin panel, a quick setup wizard opens. It asks for the panel language, an admin password and your domain.

  2. Enter the domain you copied in step 1 in the domain field.

  3. Save. If the panel says that changes need to be applied, apply them and wait until it finishes.

If something goes wrong, read How to configure the Hiddify panel properly.

docs.title: Get your connection links
docs.text:
1. In the admin panel, go to the Users section.

  2. Click a user's link to open that user's page.

  3. The user page shows the apps you can use to connect.

  4. Lower on the page you see the proxies created for that user. Scan a QR code (highlighted in yellow) with your app, or copy a link into it.

We recommend Hiddify App to connect; it works on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux.

This page only covers a quick start. The panel can do much more: read How to configure the Hiddify panel properly to get the most out of it.

docs.title: How to connect to server via SSH
How to connect to your server via SSH
docs.text: SSH is a secure way to open a command line on a remote server from your own computer. You need it to install Hiddify Manager, and to fix the panel when you cannot reach it from the web (for example, if you lost your admin link).

docs.title: What you need
docs.text:
• Your server's IP address (four numbers separated by dots, for example 1.1.1.1).
  • The username and password (or SSH key) from your server provider. The username is usually root.
  • An SSH program on your computer. Windows 10 and 11, macOS and Linux already include one.
Windows only: install SSH if it is missing

Windows 10 and 11 usually include SSH already. If the ssh command is not found:

  1. Right-click PowerShell and choose Run as Administrator.

  2. Run this command:

    Add-WindowsCapability -Online -Name OpenSSH.Client

  3. You should see a result like this:

SSH is now installed.

docs.title: Connect to the server
docs.text:
1. Open a terminal on your computer:
    • Windows: PowerShell
    • macOS: Terminal
    • Linux: Terminal

  2. Type this command, replacing <IP_Address> with your server's IP address, and press Enter:

    ssh root@<IP_Address>

    For example, if your server's IP is 1.1.1.1:

    ssh root@1.1.1.1

  3. The first time you connect, SSH asks if you trust the server (Are you sure you want to continue connecting). Type yes and press Enter.

  4. Enter your password and press Enter. The password does not appear on the screen while you type; this is normal.

When you are connected, the prompt changes to something like root@your-server:~#. You can now run commands on the server.

If you see Connection timed out or Connection refused, check the IP address and port, and make sure the server is running.

docs.title: If you changed the SSH port
docs.text:
SSH uses port 22 by default. If you changed it, add -p and your port number:

ssh root@<IP_Address> -p <port_number>

For example, if your IP is 1.1.1.1 and your port is 2222:

ssh root@1.1.1.1 -p 2222

docs.title: Useful commands after you connect
docs.text:
If Hiddify Manager is already installed, these commands help you manage it:

  • hiddify: opens the management menu.
  • hiddify admin: shows the admin panel links.
  • hiddify status: shows the status of the services.
  • hiddify restart: restarts the services.

For example, to see the admin links:

hiddify admin

To install Hiddify Manager, follow the main installation guide.

docs.title: HiddifyManager Version 8 Installation Guide
docs.text: To install HiddifyManager Version 8, follow these essential steps:

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
1. Clean Server:

  2. The server must be completely clean with no other versions of the panel or additional scripts installed.

  3. Linux Version:

  4. The server’s operating system must be Ubuntu 22.04.

docs.title: Installation Steps
docs.text:
To install Version 8, execute the following commands in order:

  1. Install pip: 
    pip install python-pip

  2. Description: This command installs Python’s package manager (pip), which is required for the subsequent steps. This tool is not pre-installed on many servers.

  3. Install Telegram Library: 

    pip install pyTelegramBotAPI==4.22.0

  4. Description: This command installs a specific version of the pyTelegramBotAPI library. HiddifyManager Version 8 is only compatible with this version (4.22.0).

  5. Install HiddifyManager Version 8: 

    bash <(curl i.hiddify.com/v8.99.0)

  6. Description: This command installs the latest release of HiddifyManager Version 8. It also properly detects and configures the associated database.

docs.title: Important Notes
docs.text:
• Ensure that the server has no conflicts with other installed versions before executing the commands.
  • Follow the steps carefully and in the correct order to avoid errors.

By following this guide, HiddifyManager Version 8 will be correctly installed on your server.

docs.title: How to install different versions of Hiddify Manager
docs.text:
You can also view and select desired versions for installation via a graphical menu by running the following command:

bash <(curl https://i.hiddify.com/custom)

This will result in the appearance of a graphical menu. Select your desired version to proceed with the installation.

docs.title: How to install different versions of HiddifyManager
docs.text:
As you know, Hidify Manager is offered in three versions as follows:

  • Develop version:

This version is a version of the software that is being developed to create the latest features. This version may have bugs, so it is better to install it on test servers.

  • Beta version:

This version is a version after the version under development, and in fact it is the version before the final release, in which part of the bugs have been fixed and it has new features.

  • Release version:

This version is actually the final version of the software that was released after the final tests and is the most stable version possible. See this figure for a better understanding.

docs.title: Install Release version
docs.text:
• Before installing, if you have already installed another version of the panel, take a backup of the panel. Read more...
  • Now just run the following one-line command in the terminal.
bash <(curl https://i.hiddify.com/release)
  • After installation, just restore your backup. Read more...

docs.title: Install Beta version
docs.text:
• Before installing, if you have already installed another version of the panel, take a backup of the panel. Read more...
  • Now just run the following one-line command in the terminal.
bash <(curl https://i.hiddify.com/beta)
  • After installation, just restore your backup. Read more...

docs.title: Install Develop version
docs.text:
• Before installing, if you have already installed another version of the panel, take a backup of the panel. Read more...
  • Now just run the following one-line command in the terminal.
bash <(curl https://i.hiddify.com/dev)
  • After installation, just restore your backup. Read more...

docs.title: Install the desired version
docs.text:
It is possible to install a custom version. Just follow the instructions below.

bash <(curl https://i.hiddify.com/vVERSION)

Here, instead of VERSION, you should enter the desired version. Suppose you want to install version 8. Just execute the following command to install the latest version 8 for you.

bash <(curl https://i.hiddify.com/v8)

From version 10, you can install exactly one specific update. For example, to install 10.7.0 version, just use the following command.

bash <(curl https://i.hiddify.com/v10.7.0)

docs.title: Installing HiddifyManager using Docker
docs.text:
An alternative to direct installation on the server is using the Docker version.

In this version, everything is done automatically. There's no need to install Docker manually, as the script will handle that for you.

To proceed, simply run the following commands:

  • Stable version: 

    bash <(curl https://i.hiddify.com/docker/latest)

  • Beta version: 

    bash <(curl https://i.hiddify.com/docker/beta)

  • Development version: 

    bash <(curl https://i.hiddify.com/docker/dev)

  • Specific version: 

    bash <(curl https://i.hiddify.com/docker/v10.80.0)

Please note that Docker support is still experimental and may have some issues. If you encounter any, kindly let us know in the comments.

Finally, you need to configure the domain. Click on this link to finalize the installation.

docs.title: Installation prerequisites
docs.text: This page lists what you need before you install Hiddify Manager: a server, the right operating system, and a way to connect to it.

docs.title: 1. A virtual server (VPS)
docs.text:
A VPS (virtual private server) is a computer in a data center that you rent and control over the internet. You can get one in several ways:

  • With a credit card or another payment method, directly from well-known data centers. Search for inexpensive servers, or see our list of providers.
  • With cryptocurrency. Many providers accept it; search for them or check our list, which marks the providers that accept crypto.
  • From Iranian providers, if you are in Iran (search). The video below (in Persian) shows how to buy a server from Iran.

docs.title: 2. Server resources
docs.text:
Suggested minimum:

  • 1 GB RAM
  • 1 CPU core
  • 10 GB storage

If the server has little memory, the installer adds temporary swap space (disk space used as extra memory) during installation.

docs.title: 3. Operating system
docs.text:
The server must run Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04 or 26.04 (amd64/x86_64 or arm64). Ubuntu is a popular version of Linux; its logo looks like this:

Ubuntu 20.04 and older, and other Linux distributions, are not supported. Choose a fresh server with nothing else installed on it.

docs.title: 4. Ports
docs.text: Hiddify needs ports 80 and 443 free; nothing else on the server should use them. If your provider has its own firewall, allow at least ports 22 (SSH), 80 and 443.

docs.title: 5. SSH access
docs.text:
To run the installation command, you connect to your server over SSH. See How to connect to the server via SSH.

To make SSH access safer, read:

  • Disable SSH password authentication
  • How to change the SSH port on your server

When you are ready, continue with the main installation guide.

docs.title: Quick installation on Ubuntu
docs.text: This page shows you how to install Hiddify Manager on your own server with one command. Hiddify Manager is the server-side panel: you install it once on a server, and then you create users and share their connection links from the panel.

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
You need:

  • A server (VPS) with a fresh install of Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04 or 26.04, on an amd64 (x86_64) or arm64 processor. Older versions such as Ubuntu 20.04 are not supported: the installer stops with the message This script only works on Ubuntu 22 and above. Other Linux distributions (Debian, CentOS, ...) are not supported either. See Installation prerequisites for how to get a server.
  • A way to connect to the server over SSH (a secure way to type commands on a remote server). See How to connect to the server via SSH.

Use a dedicated server

Install Hiddify only on a server that does nothing else. Hiddify changes the server's settings and uses ports 80 and 443, so it can break other services (websites, other panels, other VPNs) on the same server. Hiddify is also not designed for servers shared with other users or applications.

docs.title: Installation video
docs.text: The video shows an older version, so some screens look different now. The command is the same.

docs.title: Installation steps
docs.text:
1. Connect to your server over SSH as the root user. If you logged in as another user, first run this command to become root:

    sudo -i

  2. On your server, copy and run this command:

    bash <(curl https://i.hiddify.com/release)

  3. Wait until the installation finishes. It can take several minutes. The installer shows its progress on the screen.

  4. When it is done, the installer shows your admin links. Copy them and keep them in a safe place. Anyone with an admin link can manage your panel.

If the installation fails, the installer shows Installation Failed! with an error code. Run the command again; if it fails again, ask for help in the Hiddify Telegram group or on GitHub, and attach the log files from the /opt/hiddify-manager/data/log/ folder on your server.

Show the admin links again later

If you lose your admin links, connect to your server over SSH and run:

hiddify admin

Running hiddify with no extra word opens the management menu (update, restart, status, uninstall and more).

Other ways to install

  • Install on a cloud provider without SSH: Cloud-init installation.
  • Install a beta, development or specific version: Installing different versions.
  • Install with Docker (experimental): Install Hiddify using Docker.

docs.title: After installation
docs.text:
Next, you open the panel and set your domain. Follow Setting up the domain and finalizing the installation.

To get the most out of the panel, read How to configure the Hiddify panel properly.

راهکار آزادی اینترنت تمام آنچه برای اینترنت آزاد نیاز دارید هیدیفای - برای گوشی و کامپیوتر

هیدیفای یک برنامه VPN ساده و کاربرپسند است که برای iOS، اندروید، ویندوز، مک‌اواس و لینوکس در دسترس است. به‌راحتی به هیدیفای‌منیجر یا هر پنل VPN دیگری متصل شوید. این اپلیکیشن را روی موبایل یا دسکتاپ دانلود کنید و از دسترسی آزاد به اینترنت لذت ببرید.

هیدیفای‌منیجر – برای مدیریت پروکسی‌ها و کاربران

هیدیفای‌منیجر ایجاد سرور VPN شخصی را برای شما ساده می‌کند و به شما امکان می‌دهد حتی از طریق موبایل آن را مدیریت کنید. به‌راحتی می‌توانید پروکسی‌ها را با خانواده، دوستان، گروه‌ها یا حتی صدها نفر به اشتراک بگذارید.

راحت‌تر از همیشه به اینترنت آزاد متصل شوید.
  • استفاده آسان
  • بدون تبلیغات، امن و متن‌باز
  • ارائه ویژگی‌های پیشرفته مانند پشتیبانی از IPv6، انواع مختلف لینک اشتراک و بیشتر
  • پشتیبانی از طیف وسیعی از پروتکل‌های پروکسی از جمله Hysteria2، TUIC، SSH، Reality، VMess، VLESS، Trojan و ... WireGuard، AmneziaWG، Naive، Psiphon، WebSocket، Quic، gRPC، http-split، httpupgrade، ECH، کانفیگ‌های Sing-box، V2ray، Clash و Xray و بسیاری دیگر
اطلاعات بیشتر درباره هیدیفای و مشاهده کد برنامه پروکسی رایگان تستی - کانفیگ وارپ سرور فیلترشکن شخصی و اختصاصی خود را ایجاد کنید.
  • نصب آسان
  • یکی از بهترین سرورهای VPN برای ایران، چین، روسیه، برزیل و سراسر جهان
  • پشتیبانی از چند هسته، چند دامنه و مدیریت یکپارچه کاربران
  • پشتیبانی از طیف وسیعی از پروتکل‌های پروکسی از جمله Hysteria2، TUIC، Reality، VMess، VLESS، Trojan و ... Shadowsocks، WireGuard، AnyTLS، Snell، Naive، Mieru، xHTTP، httpupgrade، gRPC، WebSocket، ECH، تانل‌های DNS، پروکسی تلگرام، با هسته‌های Xray و sing-box (hiddify-core) و بسیاری دیگر
اطلاعات بیشتر درباره هیدیفای‌منیجر و مشاهده کد برنامه نصب بر روی سرور

docs.title: پرسش‌های پرتکرار
docs.text:
چگونه می‌توانم مطمئن شوم که هیدیفای امن است؟

برای اطمینان از امنیت هیدیفای، می‌توانید مراحل زیر را دنبال کنید 🔒:

  1. بررسی کد منبع 🛠️ از آنجایی که هیدیفای متن‌باز است، شما می‌توانید کد را مستقیماً در GitHub بررسی کنید تا هر گونه مسئله امنیتی یا نگرانی شناسایی شود 🔍. بررسی کد توسط خودتان یا مشورت با یک توسعه‌دهنده مطمئن می‌تواند یک اقدام مؤثر باشد ✅.

  2. بررسی بازخورد و مشارکت‌های کامیونیتی 🌐 صفحه گیت‌هاب هیدیفای و مخازن آن اغلب دارای مشارکت‌ها، گزارش مشکلات و بحث‌هایی از سوی دیگر توسعه‌دهندگان و کاربران هستند 👥. با خواندن این بحث‌ها می‌توانید به درکی از امنیت نرم‌افزار و هر گونه آسیب‌پذیری احتمالی که توسط کامیونیتی شناسایی شده است، دست یابید 🛡️.

  3. استفاده از نسخه آخر 🔄 مطمئن شوید که از آخرین نسخه هیدیفای استفاده می‌کنید، زیرا ممکن است شامل وصله‌های امنیتی و بهبودهایی باشد 🔒. می‌توانید یادداشت‌های انتشار را در GitHub بررسی کنید تا از به‌روزرسانی‌های مرتبط با امنیت مطلع شوید 📈.

  4. رعایت اصول استاندارد امنیتی 🔐 استفاده از هیدیفای در یک محیط امن شامل اعمال اصول امنیتی خوب است، مانند:

  5. محدود کردن دسترسی 🚫
  6. نظارت منظم بر فعالیت‌ها 📊

  7. به‌روزرسانی سیستم‌عامل و نرم‌افزار هیدیفای 🆙

  8. شفافیت در تنظیمات 🌟 هیدیفای‌منیجر به کاربران این امکان را می‌دهد که سرورهای خود را پیکربندی کنند و کنترل کامل بر تنظیمات پروکسی و داده‌ها داشته باشند 🔄. این شفافیت تضمین می‌کند که کاربران می‌توانند پیکربندی‌های امن خود را حفظ کرده و در صورت نیاز آن‌ها را تغییر دهند 🔄. به طور مشابه، هیدیفای به کاربران و توسعه‌دهندگان این امکان را می‌دهد که تنظیمات اپلیکیشن را متناسب با نیازهای خاص خود تنظیم و سفارشی‌سازی کنند ⚙️، از تنظیمات پروکسی گرفته تا مدیریت اتصالات 📶. با توجه به اینکه این اپلیکیشن متن‌باز است، هر گونه تغییرات یا بهبودها قابل مشاهده است و به کاربران اجازه می‌دهد تا کنترل کامل بر تجربه خود داشته باشند و امنیت و حریم خصوصی در هر مرحله حفظ شود 🔐.

با پیروی از این مراحل، می‌توانید اطمینان بیشتری در مورد امنیت هیدیفای به عنوان یک ابزار حفظ حریم خصوصی و ضد سانسور داشته باشید 🛡️✨.

هیدیفای از چه دستگاه‌هایی پشتیبانی می‌کند؟

هیدیفای برای کار با مجموعه‌ای از دستگاه‌ها و سیستم‌عامل‌ها طراحی شده است و نیازهای سمت سرور و سمت کلاینت را پوشش می‌دهد 🌐:

  1. سازگاری سمت سرور (هیدیفای‌منیجر) 🖥️ هیدیفای شامل یک برنامه سمت سرور به نام هیدیفای‌منیجر است که روی سرور Ubuntu (نسخه‌های 22.04، 24.04 یا 26.04) نصب می‌شود. هیدیفای‌منیجر با استفاده از Cloud-init به سرعت راه‌اندازی می‌شود 🚀 و این ویژگی امکان استقرار آسان را در ارائه‌دهندگان محبوب ابری و دیتاسنترها فراهم می‌کند 🌩️. این برنامه سمت سرور، پیکربندی‌ها و اتصالات کلاینت‌ها را مدیریت می‌کند و برای افرادی که به دنبال دسترسی اینترنت امن و پایدار هستند، یک ابزار قدرتمند فراهم می‌کند 🔐.

  2. سازگاری سمت کاربر (اپلیکیشن هیدیفای) 📱💻 اپلیکیشن سمت کاربر هیدیفای که به اختصار هیدیفای نامیده می‌شود، چندمنظوره است و از تمامی سیستم‌عامل‌های اصلی پشتیبانی می‌کند، از جمله:

  3. iOS 📲
  4. اندروید 🤖
  5. ویندوز 💻
  6. لینوکس 🐧
  7. مک 🍏

تیم توسعه هیدیفای به طور فعال در حال گسترش سازگاری آن با دستگاه‌های دیگر مانند روترها و دستگاه‌های ۳۲ بیتی است تا این اپلیکیشن را برای تعداد بیشتری از کاربران قابل دسترس نماید 🔄.

با این ساختار، هیدیفای یک راهکار جامع برای دور زدن سانسور اینترنت و فیلترینگ ارائه می‌دهد و به کاربران اجازه می‌دهد سرورها را به صورت مستقل راه‌اندازی کرده و به دستگاه‌های متعدد متصل شوند 🔗، در حالی که دسترسی به پلتفرم‌های مختلف را نیز گسترش می‌دهد 🌍.

آیا هیدیفای رایگان، بدون تبلیغ و متن‌باز است؟

بله، هیدیفای ویژگی‌های زیر را دارد 🌐:

  1. رایگان 💸 اپلیکیشن هیدیفای به صورت رایگان ارائه می‌شود و هیچ هزینه اشتراکی ندارد، به ویژه برای کاربران در سراسر جهان که با فیلترینگ اینترنت مواجه هستند 🌎. این برنامه به کاربران امکان می‌دهد که به سرعت با وارد کردن پروکسی‌های دریافت‌شده از سرورهای VPN شخصی (تولید شده توسط هیدیفای‌منیجر یا هر پنل VPN دیگر) یا خدمات رایگان مانند Cloudflare WARP بدون نیاز به پرداخت، متصل شوند 🔗. همچنین هیدیفای‌منیجر نیز یک ابزار ساخت سرور VPN رایگان است که برای استفاده‌های غیرتجاری توسعه داده شده است ⚙️.

  2. بدون تبلیغات 🚫📢 اپ هیدیفای و هیدیفای‌منیجر هیچ تبلیغاتی ندارند و تجربه‌ای تمیز و بدون حواس‌پرتی را برای کاربران فراهم می‌کنند 🧘‍♂️.

  3. متن‌باز 🔓 محصولات هیدیفای به صورت کامل متن‌باز است و کد آن در گیت‌هاب در دسترس است. این شفافیت به توسعه‌دهندگان اجازه می‌دهد که کد را بررسی، مشارکت و سفارشی‌سازی کنند و امنیت و انعطاف‌پذیری را تضمین می‌کند 🔍.

این ویژگی‌ها هیدیفای را به مجموعه ابزار قابل اعتماد و قابل دسترس برای کاربرانی تبدیل می‌کند که به دنبال حفظ حریم خصوصی و آزادی اینترنت بدون هیچ هزینه‌ای و بدون تبلیغات هستند 🌈🔐.

چگونه می‌توانم با تیم پشتیبانی هیدیفای تماس بگیرم؟

برای تماس با تیم پشتیبانی هیدیفای می‌توانید از کانال‌های زیر استفاده کنید 📞🌐:

  1. ایشوهای گیت‌هاب 🐞💻 برای پشتیبانی فنی یا گزارش اشکالات، می‌توانید در مخازن GitHub زیر یک ایشو (Issue) باز کنید:
  2. ریپو اپلیکیشن هیدیفای: github.com/hiddify/hiddify-app

  3. ریپو هیدیفای‌منیجر: github.com/hiddify/hiddify-manager باز کردن یک ایشو در اینجا به تیم توسعه و کامیونیتی اجازه می‌دهد که به شما کمک کنند 🤝.

  4. وب‌سایت هیدیفای 🌐 به hiddify.com مراجعه کنید تا اطلاعات تماس اضافی، منابع و مستندات را دریافت کنید 📚. وب‌سایت همچنین سوالات متداول و به‌روزرسانی‌هایی را برای کمک به سوالات رایج ارائه می‌دهد 🔄.

  5. انجمن‌ها/کانال‌های اجتماعی 📲 همچنین می‌توانید در کانال‌های اجتماعی هیدیفای به پشتیبانی دسترسی داشته باشید یا سوالات خود را بپرسید:

  6. کانال تلگرام هیدیفای: https://t.me/hiddify
  7. گروه پشتیبانی هیدیفای: https://t.me/hiddify_board
  8. کانال یوتیوب هیدیفای: youtube.com/@hiddify
  9. صفحه اینستاگرام هیدیفای: instagram.com/hiddify_com
  10. حساب X (توئیتر سابق) هیدیفای: x.com/hiddify_com

این کانال‌ها راه‌های متعددی برای ارتباط با تیم پشتیبانی و کاربران هیدیفای ارائه می‌دهند و شما را از آخرین به‌روزرسانی‌ها مطلع و کمک‌های لازم را فراهم می‌کنند 📢👥.

چگونه می‌توانم از پروژه هیدیفای حمایت کنم؟

  1. حمایت مالی 💸 شما می‌توانید با حمایت مالی از پروژه هیدیفای به توسعه و ادامه فعالیت آن کمک کنید. برای اطلاعات بیشتر و مشارکت در این بخش، به صفحه حمایت مالی هیدیفای مراجعه کنید.

  2. دادن ستاره به پروژه هیدیفای ⭐ با دادن ستاره به پروژه هیدیفای، به‌ویژه به ریپازیتوری‌های اپ هیدیفای و هیدیفای‌منیجر، می‌توانید به ارتقاء اعتبار و دیده‌شدن این پروژه در گیت‌هاب کمک کنید.

  3. مشارکت در توسعه 💻 اگر مهارت‌های فنی دارید، می‌توانید به توسعه هیدیفای کمک کنید. با مشارکت در بهبود کد، افزودن ویژگی‌های جدید، یا رفع مشکلات، می‌توانید نقشی فعال در پیشرفت این پروژه ایفا کنید. برای مشارکت، کافیست به گیت‌هاب هیدیفای مراجعه کنید.

  4. امتیازدهی پنج ستاره و نوشتن ریویو در فروشگاه‌های اپلیکیشن 🌟📱 با دادن امتیاز پنج ستاره و نوشتن ریویو برای اپ هیدیفای در فروشگاه‌های مختلف، می‌توانید به افزایش اعتبار و محبوبیت این اپلیکیشن کمک کنید و افراد بیشتری را با آن آشنا سازید. برای امتیازدهی، می‌توانید از لینک‌های زیر استفاده کنید:

  5. اپ‌استور
  6. گوگل‌پلی

  7. مایکروسافت‌استور

  8. به اشتراک‌گذاری و آگاهی‌رسانی 📢 با اشتراک‌گذاری محصولات هیدیفای، به‌ویژه هیدیفای و هیدیفای‌منیجر، در شبکه‌های اجتماعی و معرفی آن به افرادی که به ابزارهای ضد سانسور نیاز دارند، می‌توانید به گسترش این پروژه و افزایش کاربران آن کمک کنید.

  9. پیوستن به کانال‌ها و گروه‌های اجتماعی 📲 با عضویت در کانال تلگرام هیدیفای و گروه پشتیبانی، می‌توانید با دیگر کاربران در ارتباط باشید و از آخرین اخبار و بروزرسانی‌های پروژه مطلع شوید. همچنین آخرین ویدیوهای آموزشی را از کانال یوتیوب هیدیفای دنبال کنید. ما را در اینستاگرام و ایکس دنبال کنید تا از آخرین اطلاعات این پروژه مطلع شوید.

  10. کمک به تولید محتوا، به‌ویژه محتوای ویدیویی 🎥 شما می‌توانید با تولید محتوای آموزشی و تبلیغاتی درباره استفاده از هیدیفای، به گسترش آگاهی و جذب کاربران جدید کمک کنید. محتوای ویدیویی، از جمله آموزش نحوه استفاده و نصب هیدیفای و بیان مزایای آن، می‌تواند برای کاربران بسیار مفید باشد. این محتواها می‌توانند در شبکه‌های اجتماعی و پلتفرم‌های اشتراک ویدیو مانند یوتیوب و اینستاگرام منتشر شوند تا به اطلاع‌رسانی بهتر و جذب مخاطب کمک کنند.

  11. ارائه بازخورد و گزارش مشکلات 📝 با استفاده از اپلیکیشن هیدیفای و ثبت بازخوردهای خود در ریپوهای هیدیفای، به بهبود عملکرد و شناسایی مشکلات کمک کنید.

docs.title: درباره ما
docs.text:
داستان هیدیفای راهکار آزادی اینترنت

در ایران، دسترسی به اینترنت به شدت سانسور می‌شود، حتی بیشتر پس از مرگ مهسا امینی و اعتراضات پس از آن. در نتیجه، افراد عادی با محدودیت‌هایی در دسترسی به اینترنت باز مواجه شده‌اند.

پروژه هیدیفای به افراد راه‌هایی ساده و مقرون‌به‌صرفه برای دسترسی به اینترنت بدون محدودیت ارائه می‌دهد.

مخفی ساده هیدیفای داستان هیدیفای از تولد تا امروز شهریور ۱۴۰۱ تولد هیدیفای

توسعه نسخه اولیه با الهام از Awesome Freedom

آذر ۱۴۰۱ انتشار HiddifyManager نسخه اولیه

شروع استفاده از روش‌های مختلف پروکسی

تیر ۱۴۰۲ ارائه نسخه ۷ HiddifyManager

افزودن پشتیبانی از پروتکل‌های جدید

اکنون هیدیفای‌منیجر نسخه ۱۴ و اپ هیدیفای نسخه ۴

در حال کار روی نسخه‌های بعدی

تیم‌های ما توسعه

توسعه‌دهندگان ما با هیدیفای‌منیجر و برنامه هیدیفای رویاهای ما را به واقعیت تبدیل می‌کنند.

طراحی

طراحان ما تصاویر خیره‌کننده ایجاد کرده و UX محصولات هیدیفای را از طریق تست‌های کاربری بهبود می‌بخشند.

محتوا

ما محتوای جذاب و آموزنده‌ای از جمله آموزش‌های جامع ما و آموزش‌های یوتیوب گردآوری می‌کنیم.

پشتیبانی کاربران

ما همیشه برای پاسخ به پرسش‌های شما در گروه تلگرام در دسترس هستیم.

نیازمند همکاران

ما همیشه به دنبال متخصصانی هستیم که به بهبود هیدیفای کمک کنند. لطفاً رزومه خود را برای ما ارسال کنید.

ایمیل بزنید تیم توسعه

به تیم توسعه پویا ما بپیوندید! ما به دنبال توسعه‌دهندگان پایتون، کاتلین و فلاتر هستیم تا با ما نوآوری کنند. آینده تکنولوژی را شکل دهید—بیایید با هم آن را بسازیم.

تیم محتوا

آیا در ساخت ویدیوهای جذاب برای یوتیوب، ویرایش ویدیو و ایجاد محتوای بصری برای کانال‌های اجتماعی ماهر هستید؟ ما شما را به بخشی از سفر خود در تعریف دوباره خلاقیت دعوت می‌کنیم.

تیم طراحی

تجربه‌های کاربری را با تیم طراحی ما ارتقاء دهید! ما در جستجوی یک کارشناس طراحی UX/UI هستیم تا نقش مهمی در بهبود تعاملات کاربران در محصولات مختلف هیدیفای ایفا کند. اگر دید طراحی خوبی دارید، بهبود سفرهای کاربری را دوست دارید و در UX/UI تخصص دارید، ما می‌خواهیم شما بخشی از نیروی خلاق ما باشید.

می‌خواهید از هیدیفای حمایت کنید؟

آسان‌ترین راه برای حمایت از ما کلیک روی ستاره (⭐) در بالای صفحه گیت‌هاب ما است.

ما همچنین به حمایت مالی برای خدمات خود نیاز داریم. تمام فعالیت‌های ما به صورت داوطلبانه انجام می‌شود و حمایت مالی برای توسعه پروژه صرف خواهد شد. برای مشارکت، لطفاً به صفحه کمک‌های مالی ما مراجعه کنید.
